_comment: GUI parameter registry (plugin-style): add/remove parameters by editing this file only; predict_gui.py generates the form from it dynamically (restart the GUI to apply). widget options: dir|file|savefile|choice|int|bool|bool_path. 'values' holds the user's last choices (written back on window close); delete 'values' to restore factory defaults. Weight defaults are repo-relative paths under data/weights/ (predict.py resolves them against the repo root) - after downloading the three weights there, they work as-is.

params.label: Image dirs
params.help: recursively collects all images (png/jpg/jpeg/bmp/webp); folder names are not used as labels

params.label: Crop mode
params.help: center=1 center crop; five=4 corners + center; gridNxN=N^2 crops covering the whole image (4x4=16, 5x5=25; slower per image but denser sampling); multiscale=center at 0.5/1/2x; single336=control group

params.label: Aggregation
params.help: mean/topk are recommended; max raises false positives on real images (baseline only)

params.label: Batch size (crops/batch)
params.help: crops per forward batch; VRAM ~ 0.13GB x crops + 3.4GB weights (+~3GB CUDA context/workspace in Task-Manager accounting)

params.label: No resize (keep high-freq)
params.help: skip the short-side>512 -> 512 resize. Caution: high false-positive rate on high-res real images (measured FPR 0.4+)

params.label: topk k
params.help: 0 = one third of this image's crop count; only used when aggregate=topk

params.label: fp16 mixed precision
params.help: fp16 mixed precision, noticeably faster (overflow bug fixed), recommended

params.label: Export per-crop scores CSV
params.help: for error analysis: the individual score of every crop of every image

params.label: JSON format
params.help: detailed=meta header + is_fake boolean per image (daily/experiment use); competition=one {image_path,pred} item per image (competition deliverable format, top-level list)

params.label: Output JSON
params.help: empty = auto-named by timestamp under results_gui/, avoiding overwrites

advanced.label: Device
advanced.help: cpu is extremely slow, only when no GPU is available

advanced.label: DataLoader processes
advanced.help: keep 0: preprocessing is ~3ms/image, workers only add memory
